about_the_game:
Unlock new jigsaw puzzles in "Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle - Expansion Pack 2"! This DLC adds fresh, stunning scenes of powerful bears and cunning wolves in breathtaking landscapes.

Features:

🐻 New Wildlife Puzzles – More bears, more wolves, more stunning nature!
🧩 Expanded Challenge – Solve additional 30 to 285-piece puzzles.
🎨 High-Quality Artwork – Beautiful, realistic visuals bring the wild to life.
🎵 Same Relaxing Gameplay – No timers, just pure puzzle enjoyment.

Enhance your puzzle collection with new jigsaw challenges and experience even more of nature’s fiercest rivalry!
